purpose: Reusable source-only inventory for the next African city rollout; records existing cached data and bounded pilot packs only. It does not claim green status or whole-country playable coverage.

coverageExtent.scope: Natural Earth outlines/admin1 are contextual national geometry. Overture manifests are small bounded city-cell samples. Neither is nationwide or citywide coverage.

gaps: Natural Earth country/admin1/city-point layers provide no street-scale transport, buildings, airport footprints or terrain.
Benin/Cotonou and Côte d’Ivoire/Abidjan have no matching city-cell Overture building/road pilot in inspected cached campaign outputs.
Dakar, Cape Town and Addis Ababa have only the enumerated bounded Overture cell samples; no citywide or countrywide completeness is established.
Climate data was unavailable in existing city pilot manifests.
No urban source-cell set was found for Cotonou or Abidjan; later map acquisition must produce and validate it before these regions can be presented as full playable cities.
